compactRecord.rs: A low (630 m) saddle in the Swabian Alb foothills; pleasant pastoral scenery and an adjacent gliding airfield add mild interest, but the simple state road has no hairpins, no dramatic gradients, and virtually no fame outside the Schwäbisch Gmünd area.
compactRecord.td: Furtlepass is a gentle 630 m saddle on Baden-Württemberg's L1160, crossing the Rems–Fils watershed on the Swabian Alb plateau. It offers peaceful forested countryside, a gliding airfield, hiking trails, and local cycling-marathon fame, but lacks dramatic alpine character.
